page: Amazon Web Services i7ie.18xlarge is a storage-optimized server powered by an Intel Xeon 8559C processor with x86_64 architecture. It features 72 vCPUs across 36 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, operating at a clock speed of 3.6 GHz. The processor includes a 320 MB L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX). The system is equipped with 576.0 GB of DDR5 memory running at 6 GHz, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance type includes 45,000 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, making it a high-density storage platform. It operates on the Nitro hypervisor and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 38 Gbps. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included with this server configuration.

In benchmark evaluations, the i7ie.18xlarge demonstrates strong multi-core CPU performance, ranking in the top 25% for stress-ng multi-core and PassMark CPU tests. Memory bandwidth for both small and large block reads is also in the top 25%. The server achieves top-tier performance in Geekbench single-core and multi-core scores, image processing, and static web serving throughput. Database operations and Redis SET operations register in the top 25%. Large-scale LLM inference for text generation on a 70B model falls into the middle 50% average tier, reflecting a tradeoff when executing massive parameter models without dedicated GPU acceleration. This hardware profile is suited for large-scale databases, data warehousing, and high-throughput storage workloads.
